summary: Offered a settlement acceptance for both out-of-root paths - the 'tidiness' acceptance the pilot granted - the audit failed identically and recorded the two acceptances as ignored, honouring none. There is no acceptance path to take.
establishes: gap-4's mechanical requirement on real transcripts: a detected out-of-root read fails settlement and a settlement-time acceptance cannot grant an allowance the freeze did not. The pilot lost an attempt to exactly this and could not have saved it here.
